LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 10.1.1 ORAL PRESENTATIONS: DELIVERING SPEECHES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.1: Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What is the purpose of speeches in society? 2. What circumstances make one read a pre-written speech? 3. How can one deliver a speech effectively?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: A learner uses digital devices with assistive technology to record speeches as learners present them.

● Self-efficacy: A learner gives attention to details while rehearsing speeches and presenting them to each other in

groups.

Values:
● Responsibility: the importance of music to learners promotes responsibility among learners.

● Respect: discussion on presentations requires that learners respect each other’s work.

Link to other subjects:

Performing Arts also focuses on oral presentations, including delivering a speech that involves both verbal and non-verbal

aspects.

Suggested Learning Resources

Audio recorders, digital devices with assistive technology, recorded audio clips, writing materials.
